newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Cinema Plus to open Adelaide IMAX screen.
newsitem.headline: Cinema Plus to open Adelaide IMAX screen.

text.p: Cinema Plus Ltd said on Monday it had entered into an agreement to open a giant-screen IMAX movie theatre in Adelaide's entertainment district.

The 276-seat cinema would be operated by Cinema Plus and leased from the developer and owner of the complex, Metrocorp, with the theatre expected to be operating in March 1998, subject to development and planning approvals.
Cinema Plus's total financial commitment would be about A$3.5 million, the company said, with Metrocorp responsible for funding all other development costs.
